GOVERNMENT SCHEMES Bima Sakhi Yojana

# Page 2^page=2


# Page 3^page=3
o Launch: 2000 o Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises o Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises(CGTMSE) ▪ Established by Ministry of MSMEs and Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) ▪ Corpus of CGTMSE contributed by Government of India and SIDBI in ratio of 4:1 o Aim: To make available collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprise sector(MSEs) by providing credit guarantee to Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) o Eligible Activities ▪ New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises engaged in manufacturing or service activity excluding Agriculture, Self Help Groups (SHGs), etc

# Page 4^page=4
o Eligible Lending Institutions ▪ Scheduled commercial banks (Public/Private Sector Banks/Foreign Banks) and select Regional Rural Banks ▪ NBFCs, Small Finance Banks (SFBs), Scheduled Urban Co-operative Banks, Microfinance Institutions ▪ National Small Industries Corporation Ltd. (NSIC), North Eastern Development Finance Corporation Ltd. (NEDFi) and SIDBI

# Page 5^page=5
▪ Fund and non-fund based (Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantee etc.) credit facilities up to ₹5 crore (earlier ₹2 crore) per eligible borrower

# Page 6^page=6
▪ Tenure of guarantee cover - 5 years (or as specified) ▪ For settlement of claims in respect of guarantees for loan outstanding upto ₹10 lakh(earlier ₹5 lakh), initiation of legal proceedings not required

Q. Consider the following statement with respect to the Bima Sakhi Yojana? 1. Women selected for the program will receive specialized training and a stipend for three years to promote financial literacy and insurance awareness. 2. A. 1 and 2 Only B. 3 C. 1 and 3 only D. 1 Only E. None of the Above Answer: Option A
